topic: measurement designs exhausted: single 0.336 s window is the binding constraint

designs_tried.outcome: broadband cross-correlation 0.10; coherence 0.42-0.63 at 4-8 kHz; no reliable band

designs_tried.design: band-limited noise, one band per run
designs_tried.outcome: best mean coherence 0.537 at 4-6 kHz; 2 usable bins of 4097

designs_tried.design: band-limited noise, two repeats per band
designs_tried.outcome: best mean coherence 0.439 at 4-6 kHz; 1 usable bin; no improvement over -6 dBFS

why_level_does_not_help: a 12 dB source increase bought only 4-9 dB of SNR, so roughly half of the interfering energy scales with the source; it is reverberant tail beyond the 512-tap (10.5 ms) memory, not additive noise
binding_constraint: every capture is a single 16384-frame (0.336 s) window, so an impulse response estimated from that window cannot be validated on another window of the same excitation
conclusion: model fitting is not physically possible with the current capture interface; no fourth estimator will change this
requested_from_C: either longer raw PCM, or several consecutive 0.336 s captures returned together from a single overlay load
